text:
kevin_cs: Heads-up — MerchantEdge renewal stuck. They signed commercial but procurement refuses to attach PO until the invoice billing entity matches their AP system. Quote: https://docsend.com/s/merchantedge-q4.

priya_ae: which entity did they use on the PO?

kevin_cs: they submitted PO for MerchantEdge Holdings Ltd but our invoice is set to MerchantEdge Inc (US). customer wants EU billing entity on invoice (MerchantEdge EU SARL).

sam_fin: we can't change billing entity without finance approval and tax docs. need company reg + VAT number for EU entity to create vendor.

vendor_bot: Vendor lookup: "MerchantEdge EU SARL" -> no match. Suggest temp vendor code TEMP-ME-557.

dolores_legal: Also flag: customer requested term change from net30 -> net60. Sales approved conditional discount but legal needs explicit language about late fees and FX responsibility. I can prep the clause now.

rob_se: I can create an amendment SOW with new billing entity and attach legal clause. Will generate DocuSign and include a note for PO attachment.

priya_ae: buyer contact is ap@merchantedge.eu and CFO is claire@merchantedge.eu. They said they can provide VAT & reg number in reply.

sam_fin: ok please request VAT number. I'll provision TEMP-ME-557 to let them attach PO while vendor creation completes.

rob_se: DocuSign prepared: https://docusign.com/envelope/me-2024-88 routed to Claire (CFO) then AP team. Included Dolores' clause: "Invoices issued to MerchantEdge EU SARL; payment net60; customer responsible for FX and late fees per schedule."

kevin_cs: pinged Claire to upload VAT/reg docs and attach PO. asked for signature by EOD Friday to lock pricing.

vendor_bot: Reminder: DocuSign envelope set to expire in 10 days. Temporary vendor code TEMP-ME-557 assigned.

priya_ae: Claire replied with VAT EU-987654321 and attached reg doc at 1759996000.

sam_fin: received VAT doc, creating permanent vendor: ENT-ME-291. will confirm once live.

dolores_legal: quick note — please ensure the amendment includes: "If Buyer requests net60, Seller may apply a 10-day invoice processing window standard; late payment interest at 1.25% monthly." paste that exact sentence.

rob_se: updated DocuSign text accordingly and re-routed. Envelope shows Claire viewed at 1759997200.

kevin_cs: Claire signed at 1759997600; AP attached PO and referenced ENT-ME-291 in notes.

sam_fin: vendor created ENT-ME-291 at 1759997920. finance will process invoice. closing once invoice queued.

kevin_cs: great work. status: SOW amended and signed, PO attached, vendor created. follow-up: schedule onboarding seat provisioning for next week. :white_check_mark:
